messages:
Asha (partnerships): Quick heads-up — Skylark field-kit dry run next Tue 11:00am PT. Need run-of-show, speaker cues, demo order, and final swag/packing list. Can folks confirm availability? :calendar:
Diego (field-eng): I can own demo flow and HW smoke tests. Need access to the Skylark test image and the model weights before EOD Monday. @Kara can you push latest kv-cache patch into the field image?
Kara (hw-partner): Will push the image by EOD today. Also, we need to confirm power adapters in the kit (US/EU/UK). Skylark will include an extra battery pack.
Priya (solutions): I will draft speaker prep + talking points. I'll drop a link to the runbook once it's up: https://docs.google.com/example/skylark-fieldkit-runbook
Ben (events): Booth staffing — Alex & Ming are confirmed for the first shift. Need two people for teardown (5pm). How many shirts/sizes are we printing? @Asha
Asha (partnerships): Swag manifest so far: 100 shirts (S:20, M:40, L:30, XL:10), 50 stickers, 30 mini SSD drives for demos. Skylark ops to ship swag to our SF office by Fri AM. Shipping address: 123 Redwood Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107. Use FedEx overnight and mark as "Event: Skylark Joint". :package:
Diego (field-eng): Hardware checklist for the pack — please confirm and add if anything missing:
```
- 2x Skylark Edge nodes (fw v1.4.2)
- 1x external battery pack (20000mAh)
- 3x power cords (US, EU, UK)
- 1x USB-C console cable
- 1x preloaded SSD (weights_v2.tar.gz)
- 1x router (if venue network flaky)
- test script: ./run_field_smoke.sh
- spare NVMe and SATA cables
```
Kara (hw-partner): Confirmed on adapters. We'll include an extra console cable and a labelled inventory sheet inside each kit. Also: partner marketing needs co-branded collateral for the marketplace listing — one-pager and a hero image.
Leah (marketing): I can produce the 1-pager and a co-branded slide. Need high-res Skylark and Redwood logos (SVG) by Wednesday COB. @Kara can you share? Also ask legal for the joint announcement blurb draft.
Kara (hw-partner): Requested SVGs from Skylark brand team — they said tomorrow morning.
Priya (solutions): Speaker lineup draft: Asha (Redwood intro), Tom (Skylark tech + demo), Diego (field smoke + troubleshooting), Priya (moderator / Q&A). Proposal: 10-min intros, 20-min demo, 15-min live Q&A, 5-min closing. Can Tom confirm? @Tom (skylark)
Tom (skylark): Confirmed, will prepare a focused demo showing cold start -> warm cache improvement. Need ~2 minutes to set expectations at start.
Asha (partnerships): Recommend a full dry-run day-before at 4:00pm PT to validate Zoom, AV, and demo flow. Ben, can you lock a conference room and Zoom?
Ben (events): Booked Conference Room A, Zoom meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode in invite). I sent calendar invites to all participants and Skylark attendees. Also added the runbook to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/ENG/Skylark+Field+Kit+Runbook
Logistics Bot: Calendar invite and Zoom link have been created and shared with external guests.
Priya (solutions): I'll circulate speaker notes and the dry-run checklist by Mon 12:00pm PT. Please review and add any gotchas (power tolerances, demo timeouts, fallback slides).
Asha (partnerships): Perfect — thanks everyone. Action items recap: Kara push image (EOD), Diego finalize test script + pack list, Leah create 1-pager (need logos), Ben lock room & Zoom (done), Priya circulate notes Mon noon. See you at the dry-run. :thumbsup:
